title: Princeton Celebrates Anne Carson, a Nobel Prize Winner Who Was Denied Tenure
summary: Carson, who was awarded the Literature prize on Thursday, was denied tenure when teaching at the university in the 1980s, leading social media users to mock a congratulatory message.
